name: PHRX 5155
title: Professional Experience in International Pharmacy II
description: The student will experience pharmacy practice and healthcare systems in the host country and compare them to those in the U.S. Experiences may include, but are not limited to, community-based clinics, inpatient settings and/or industry. Non-direct patient care.
requirement_description: PHRX 5047 or PHRX 5065; open to students in the School of Pharmacy.
